basics.name: Pranshu Jawade
basics.label: Principal Platform Engineer
basics.summary: Principal Platform Engineer specializing in cloud security and distributed systems with 10+ years architecting enterprise-scale platforms. Expert in Kubernetes, Azure infrastructure, and identity management. Delivered 6+ production platforms serving millions of users across Microsoft's multi-cloud environments. Built and led teams of up to 89 engineers. CTO experience with venture that raised $4.8M and achieved successful acquisition. Authored 20+ architecture documents solving novel security challenges.

work.summary: Azure Security - Identity and Access Protection
highlights: Tenant Automation & Isolation Platform: Proposed and secured executive buy-in for critical security platform following 2023-24 security incidents; protects all Microsoft clouds (public Azure, sovereign, air-gapped)
Architected orchestration engine and agent-based eviction system; authored 20+ technical documents including Strategy papers, HLD/LLD, ADRs, and security compliance documentation
Built and hired 16-engineer team; delivered production platform in 6 months enabling automated threat actor eviction and blast radius reduction
App Governance Platform: Architected from scratch and delivered production platform in 1 month; now governs all Microsoft Entra applications company-wide
Core Identity Platform: Founding architect for Microsoft's cloud identity transformation; replaced legacy Microsoft Identity Manager (MIM), enabling migration to cloud-native Entra ID
Built 11-engineer team in India, collaborated with 12-engineer Redmond team; delivered platform processing 3-5M daily requests for user provisioning, groups, and entitlements
Served as Primary SOX Control Owner for 16 controls for 3 years; maintained audit compliance for all Microsoft, LinkedIn, and GitHub identity operations
Self-Service Password Reset: Architected platform serving 10-15k daily password resets; successfully decommissioned in 2023 as part of Microsoft's passwordless authentication initiative
Azure Virtual Desktop Management: Architected React-based self-service portal; scaled from IAM pilot to Microsoft-wide deployment managing 50k+ AVD instances

work.position: Programmer Analyst II | CTO, EOL Internal Venture
work.summary: CTO & Founding Member of EOL (End of Life) - Boeing Incubator Program
highlights: Selected from Boeing internal incubator program to serve as Founding CTO for venture addressing aircraft parts supply chain challenges
Recruited, hired, and led 89-person engineering team in Memphis, Texas; secured $4.8M across three funding rounds from internal Boeing sponsors
Built cross-platform web and mobile applications; pioneered blockchain-based aircraft parts tracking system - first blockchain supply chain solution in commercial aviation
Successfully acquired by Inventory Locator Service (ILS), a Boeing subsidiary, in 2019
Acquisition Portal Modernization: Re-architected legacy ColdFusion system using .NET Core and ELSA Workflow; reduced approval cycles by 40%
SAP-Azure DevOps Integration: Designed RESTful APIs bridging SAP Solution Manager with Azure DevOps; automated work package synchronization for 200+ project managers
Created reusable mobile architecture templates adopted by 15+ Boeing development teams

work.summary: Founded consulting company as solo freelancer; scaled to 6-person team
highlights: Scaled to 6-person team generating ₹8 Lacs monthly revenue
Delivered web development, mobile applications, cloud consulting, and SAP Hybris implementations
Clients included Littler Associates, Fabrico Laundry, NHAI, and POS systems for restaurants
Closed company in 2022 to focus on full-time role at Microsoft
Developed .NET-based enterprise web applications adhering to SOLID principles and clean architecture patterns
Built responsive UIs using Angular with REST API integration
Implemented automated testing and CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI and Cypress

work.summary: Web application development for SMB clients
highlights: Developed web applications using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and ASP.NET
Created SQL queries and stored procedures for business applications
